_note: Sources the currency watcher polls for the Australian pack. content_hash is set on each successful fetch; a changed hash is what triggers triage. Empty hash means never fetched. Every jurisdiction has a source: a jurisdiction with no source is one the watcher reports as unchanged while never looking at it, which is indistinguishable from a clean scan. The watcher writes its state to the user's overlay copy of this file, never to the shipped one.

sources.name: ABCB / NCC news
sources.catches: NCC amendments, adoption dates, new handbooks, calculators, CPD material

sources.name: NCC adoption and editions
sources.catches: A new edition, or a jurisdiction changing its adoption date. Changes which edition governs new jobs.

sources.name: SafeWork NSW codes of practice
sources.catches: New or revised approved codes. Mandatory under WHS Act s26A since 01.07.2026, so a new code is a new obligation, not new guidance.

sources.name: Safe Work Australia model codes of practice
sources.catches: Model codes, which states then adopt. Gives early warning of a state code before it lands.

sources.name: NSW Planning Portal
sources.catches: CDC and DA pathway changes, complying development reform

sources.name: NSW building and construction legislation
sources.catches: Building (Approvals and Practitioners) Act 2026 commencement, DBP Act changes, Security of Payment amendments
sources.note: legislation.nsw.gov.au and parliament.nsw.gov.au both return HTTP 403 to automated requests. This page covers the same ground; the Act text itself is read manually when needed.

sources.name: Standards Australia new releases
sources.catches: New and revised AS/NZS. Numbers and titles are facts and monitorable; clause text is licensed and never copied.
sources.note: JavaScript storefront - a plain fetch yields no text, and standards.org.au pages return an identical 253-character shell. Checked by a person; record it with --manual standards-au-new.
sources.manual_check: Open the URL, scan for new or revised standards that supersede anything in standards/index.json, then run --manual to record the check.

sources.name: WorkSafe Victoria laws and regulations
sources.catches: Victoria runs the OHS Act 2004 and its own compliance codes, not the model WHS laws. A NSW code of practice has no application here.

sources.name: Victorian planning schemes and practice notes
sources.catches: Changes to the approval pathway for fitout and change-of-use work. planning.vic.gov.au returns HTTP 403 to automated requests — checked by a person on the weekly or monthly cadence and recorded with --manual.

sources.name: Victorian legislation — security of payment
sources.catches: The Act as amended from 15.04.2026. Two provisions of the amending Act had not commenced at August 2026 — this is what catches their commencement.

sources.name: WorkSafe Queensland codes of practice
sources.catches: New or revised approved codes in Queensland. worksafe.qld.gov.au has returned HTTP 403 to automated requests on every scan since 25 August 2026 — converted to manual watch 21 September 2026; checked by a person on the weekly or monthly cadence and recorded with --manual.

sources.name: WorkSafe WA codes of practice
sources.catches: WA adopted its own WHS Act 2020; its codes differ from the model set.

sources.name: SafeWork SA codes of practice
sources.catches: New or revised approved codes in South Australia. safework.sa.gov.au returns HTTP 403 to automated requests — checked by a person on the weekly or monthly cadence and recorded with --manual.

sources.name: WorkSafe Tasmania codes of practice
sources.catches: New or revised approved codes in Tasmania. worksafe.tas.gov.au returns HTTP 403 to automated requests — checked by a person on the weekly or monthly cadence and recorded with --manual.

sources.name: NT WorkSafe codes of practice
sources.catches: New or revised approved codes in the Northern Territory. worksafe.nt.gov.au returns HTTP 403 to automated requests at every path — checked by a person on the weekly or monthly cadence.

sources.name: WorkSafe ACT codes of practice
sources.catches: New or revised approved codes in the ACT.

not_monitored.why: Paywalled and licensed. Only the published list of numbers and titles is monitored; wording comes from the firm's licensed copies at the time it is needed.
No active project in those jurisdictions. Added when the registry gains one - the watcher keys off registry jurisdiction, so an unused source is noise.
